scripts.build:binary: bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmdz && ([ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ] || codesign --force --sign - dist/cmdz)
scripts.test:binary: bun run build:binary && python3 scripts/standalone-smoke.py dist/cmdz
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test
